newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all rise, gas oil by $4 a tonne.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all rise, gas oil by $4 a tonne.

text.p: NWE oil products were all stronger on Thursday with gas oil up by $4 a tonne.
Dealers said gas oil gained $4 a tonne on prompt demand for diesel and strong gains on the IPE futures.
Gasoline was $1-2 stronger on physical barges at $190 for eurograde while swaps in August gained $3-4 as surging NYMEX crude and gasoline drew numbers higher.
Naphtha moved up strongly on a confirmed open spec deal at $191 CIF NWE, several dollars above previus quotes, and supported by Thursday's jump in crude futures values.
Fuel rose $1 on higher swaps and a shortage of prmopt material.
